mapper.select: SELECT batch_id,scope_type,tenant_id,state,older_than,object_key,object_version,sha256,row_count,payload_bytes FROM audit_archive_batch WHERE batch_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT approval_reference FROM audit_archive_cutover_grant WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND effective_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE

SELECT policy_code,policy_version,online_days,total_days,approval_reference FROM audit_archive_retention_policy WHERE scope_type=#{scope.type} AND tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND approved_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY policy_code,policy_version FOR UPDATE
SELECT hold_id FROM audit_archive_hold FORCE INDEX (ix_audit_archive_active_hold) WHERE scope_type=#{scope.type} AND tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} AND released_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id FROM audit_archive_member m JOIN audit_archive_batch b ON b.batch_id=m.batch_id JOIN audit_operation_attempt a ON a.id=m.attempt_id AND a.scope_type=b.scope_type AND a.actor_tenant_id=b.tenant_id WHERE m.batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.attempt_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE o FROM audit_attempt_outcome o JOIN audit_archive_member m ON m.attempt_id=o.attempt_id WHERE m.batch_id=#{id}
DELETE p FROM platform_audit p JOIN audit_archive_member m ON m.attempt_id=p.audit_attempt_id WHERE m.batch_id=#{id}
DELETE a FROM audit_operation_attempt a JOIN audit_archive_member m ON m.attempt_id=a.id WHERE m.batch_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_archive_batch SET state='ONLINE_PURGED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state='VERIFIED'
